thread:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for `metrics-ingest` (PD-18273) — high kafka consumer lag + Prometheus scrape failures in eu-west-1. Impacting log ingestion and real-time metrics ship. https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-18273

pagerbot: pd-18273 assigned to @maria (oncall) — notify escalation policy.

maria: taking this. quick triage: checking consumer groups + prom scrape status.

sam: saw some WARNs in log-processor earlier, possible OOM/GC thrash. also seeing scrape errors: `dial tcp: i/o timeout` from prometheus -> metrics-exporter.

lee: support pinged me, a couple of customers reporting slower dashboards (timestamps delayed ~3-6m). not widespread yet but increasing.

maria: running checks now — kafka consumer group lag:```bash
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-eu1:9092 --describe --group log-ingest
# output
# TOPIC           PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
ingest-logs         0         1242345         1242460         115
ingest-logs         1         984321          994000          9679
```looks like partition 1 lag large. also prometheus shows repeated 503 from exporter for host metrics-exporter-eu1-2.

sam: can you paste the last few lines from log-processor on that pod? suspecting repeated JVM restarts.

maria: grabbing logs —```log
[2026-03-14T10:15:02Z] ERROR main - oom after full gc
[2026-03-14T10:15:02Z] INFO  main - restarting consumer loop
[2026-03-14T10:17:09Z] ERROR main - segfault at native code
```not great. oncall runbook says restart deployment, check JVM flags, and if consumer keeps failing -> failover to backup consumer pool.

alex: I'll prepare backup consumer pool in us-east-1, but that will add cross-region egress cost. do we want that now?

maria: prioritize customer impact mitigation first. scaling consumers in eu-west-1 + cordoning bad nodes. steps: 1) kubectl scale deployment/log-processor --replicas=6 -n ingest 2) kubectl cordon node with high OOM 3) temporarily suppress the noisy prom alert for exporter for 10m (so oncall noise doesn't drown ops).

sam: +1. also bump consumer count to drain lag faster, then examine GC settings.

maria: running scale now:```bash
kubectl scale deployment/log-processor -n ingest --replicas=6
kubectl get pods -l app=log-processor -n ingest -o wide
```pods spinning up. will monitor consumer lag.

pagerbot: PD-18273 acknowledged by maria at 2026-03-14T10:20:15Z.

maria: consumer lag after scaling:```text
partition 1 lag: 9679 -> 2400 (2m)
partition 0 lag stable small
```improvement but still behind. starting a rolling restart for deployment to pick up JVM config tweak from candidate config.

lee: suppressing prometheus alert prometheus:ExporterDown (eu-west-1) for 10m per runbook suppression. noted in channel.

sam: also temporarily enabling fallback S3 sink to avoid message loss if consumer crashes again: toggled env S3_FALLBACK=true for log-processor configmap and restarted.

maria: note: a few customers (invoice-service, analytics-saas) showed >5m ingestion delay. support notified with mitigation ETA ~15m. adding note to incident ticket.

alex: started up backup consumers in us-east-1, they can accept re-routed traffic if eu-west continues to degrade. holding off DNS flip until we see persistent failure.

maria: after restart + scale + fallback, lag decays: partition 1 2400 -> 300 in 8m. prometheus scrape errors drop after cordoning node (network hiccup suspected).

sam: looks like JVM memory config underprovisioned after recent heap growth. root cause candidate: GC tuning regression from last config change. opening follow-up bug: INFRA-3421.

pagerbot: PD-18273 status changed to "mitigated" by maria at 2026-03-14T10:43:12Z.

maria: marking incident mitigated. customer impact limited to delayed ingest (no data loss due to fallback). will run postmortem tomorrow: notes: 1) fix JVM flags for log-processor 2) improve autoscaling for consumer group 3) refine prom alert thresholds to avoid noise during rollout.

lee: leaving a short message for support: "ingest delays resolved; customers may see backlog clear over next 10-20m. reopen if any 5xx spikes."

sam: adding playbook item: automate fallback toggle for S3 when lag > X and restarts > Y.

maria: handing off to alex for follow-up/outage writeup. alex — assigning to you and tagging postmortem. I'm back on normal rota.

alex: got it. will own infra bug + postmortem. thanks team. :white_check_mark:

incidentbot: Incident thread closed (mitigated) — follow-up: INFRA-3421, PM: alex, RCA due in 48h.
